en.headline: City Chamber Orchestra stages Space Fantasy family shows this weekend
en.dek: Three English-language performances run at Tsuen Wan Town Hall on Saturday and Sunday, combining live music, dance, theatre and circus for ages three and up.
body: The City Chamber Orchestra of Hong Kong is presenting Space Fantasy, a family-oriented production, at Tsuen Wan Town Hall Auditorium this weekend with performances at 3 pm and 7.30 pm on Saturday and 3 pm on Sunday.

The show follows an alien character’s journey to Earth inspired by NASA’s Voyager probes, blending live orchestral music with dance, theatre and circus elements. Tickets start at HK$120 and are available through URBTIX.
The organisers said the programme is suitable for children aged three and above and forms part of the orchestra’s 2026-27 season of accessible classical events.

zh.headline: 城市室樂團《太空幻遊》本周末荃灣大會堂上演
zh.dek: 周六下午3時及晚上7時半、周日下午3時於荃灣大會堂演奏廳演出，英語家庭節目，門票120元起。
body: 香港城市室樂團本周末於荃灣大會堂演奏廳呈獻合家歡節目《太空幻遊》，周六下午3時及晚上7時半、周日下午3時共三場。
節目以NASA旅行者號探測器為靈感，講述一名外星人前往地球的旅程，結合現場管弦樂、舞蹈、劇場及馬戲元素。門票由120元起，於城市售票網發售。
主辦方表示節目適合三歲或以上觀眾，屬樂團2026-27樂季普及古典音樂活動之一。
